description: This file contains unit tests for the Abseil hashing library, including tests for hash functions, hash value consistency, hash of various data types, and custom hash behaviors. It extensively tests the hashing of standard and custom types, including containers, tuples, pointers, and special types, ensuring correctness and consistency of the hashing implementation.

classes.name: TypeErasedValue
classes.description: A wrapper for testing AbslHashValue with type erasure, supporting comparison and hashing.

classes.name: TypeErasedContainer
classes.description: A container wrapper for testing hash erasure, exposing value_type and supporting initializer list construction.

classes.name: TypeErasedVector
classes.description: A type-erased vector container for testing.

classes.name: PiecewiseHashTester
classes.description: A helper class for testing piecewise buffer hashing, splitting input at specified offsets.

classes.name: Private
classes.description: A private type used to test recursive hashing behavior within absl::Hash.

classes.name: DummyFooBar
classes.description: A dummy object that hashes as two concatenated buffers 'foo' and 'bar'.

classes.name: ValueWithBoolConversion
classes.description: A type with an implicit bool conversion operator, used to test that hashing does not rely on implicit conversions.

methods.name: AbslHashValue
methods.description: Overloads for hashing various user-defined types and containers, supporting different hashing strategies.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Function object for computing hash values, supporting various types and custom behaviors.

methods.name: HashOf
methods.description: Function for hashing a single argument or multiple arguments as a tuple.

methods.name: VerifyTypeImplementsAbslHashCorrectly
methods.description: Test utility to verify correct implementation of AbslHashValue for given types.
